triage.why: With fee = -1379951932, withdraw debits only quantity + fee yet transfers the full quantity, so the user receives 1379951932 more tokens than they are debited; a negative fee should be rejected (and fee should be >= minFee).
Same negative-fee flaw: the debit is quantity minus the fee, feesAccrued does not move, so the balance drop does not equal quantity plus booked fee.
The extra 1379951932 paid out comes from tokens backing other users' balances and fees, so liabilities now exceed the bridge's holdings: value taken from nothing.
